column1: # Every operation `just bench-compare` can time, read by all five arms: the
# command-line name, the row name (rows print as Benchmark<row>/<input>), the
# directory in bench/corpus-gen/ the inputs come from, and the output buffer:
# bytes per input byte, as N or N/D, or 0 for none. Every arm allocates
# n * out + 64 bytes for an input of n bytes before it times anything. An arm
# maps each name to its function, and prints a `# SKIP` line for one it lacks.
